hypotheses.T1_factor_shapley_recomposes_routes: QK1/QK2/value behavioral Shapley effects reconstruct every frozen and oracle insertion/removal route within 1e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.T2_value_content_dominates_layer4: At layer 4, value has at least 50% median absolute downstream Shapley share for the frozen route on both corpora.
hypotheses.T3_qk_routing_is_nontrivial: At layer 4, QK1 plus QK2 have at least 15% median absolute downstream Shapley share for the frozen route on both corpora.
hypotheses.T4_local_factor_mix_predicts_downstream_: Frozen-route local factor projections correlate at least 0.50 with downstream removal Shapley projections across records and layers on both corpora.
hypotheses.T5_factor_mix_transfers_ood: At layer 4, FineWeb and TinyStories frozen-route median absolute downstream factor shares have L1 distance at most 0.25.
hypotheses.T6_factor_attribution_is_cross_world_sta: Frozen-route insertion and removal factor projections correlate at least 0.70 across records and layers on both corpora.
hypotheses.T7_frozen_and_oracle_use_similar_factors: At layer 4, frozen and oracle median downstream-removal factor vectors have cosine at least 0.80 on both corpora.
